assertion_audit.fails_if: the raw exported version or fixed decision fields differ from the independent literal expectations, or the raw grid, wall or psi differs from the source trace; a matching corruption in both raw parsers could survive
a wallless crossing no longer falls back to its four-point polygon or the resulting ring fails to close at its first point
a wall with distinct first and last segment endpoints is closed by repeating its last endpoint instead of its first
an inconsistent flag, zero-width binary64 bracket, or unchanged decision key ceases to raise SystemExit; the red base log demonstrates the zero-width case
bisected_offset returns a value other than the one fixed fixture value 0.1613; a hard-coded 0.1613 return survives because the assertion uses the receipt and entry returned by the same call
bisected_brackets yields zero or more than one item for a one-item receipt; truncating a multi-bracket receipt to its first item survives
requested or achieved carrier cell counts cease to be checked against the receipt and the two mismatched examples no longer raise SystemExit
a missing input raises or is silently omitted instead of returning an explicit unread row with the FileNotFoundError cause

findings.text: blocking: The only bisected_brackets assertion supplies one bracket and no checked-in test invokes export_tie_islands.main; reverting its loop to the first bracket or just the left side leaves the 16-test gate green while losing required endpoints.

follow-on: The offset assertion compares output with an entry returned by the same helper and the one fixed fixture value 0.1613; a hard-coded 0.1613 return would pass, so a varied receipt is needed to prove receipt-derived offsets.
